title: Uncle Steve Is an Alien Parasite Part 1

series.summary: Rick discovers that beloved Uncle Steve is actually a telepathic alien parasite that implants false memories, prompting a complete quarantine lockdown when another bizarre character appears.

cuts.voiceover_text: Beloved Uncle Steve surprises the family with dream vacation tickets to Paris. Everyone adores him. But he does not actually exist.
Jerry insists his goofy brother has lived with them for months. Rick takes one look at the stranger and immediately blasts a hole through his chest.
On the floor, the body morphs into a grotesque alien parasite. Rick reveals these telepathic monsters survive by implanting fake memories into human brains.
Summer defends her memories, but Rick warns they could already be infested. Suddenly, Mr. Poopybutthole appears. Rick completely trusts him and seals the house in lockdown.
